genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. The assessment concerns the exact YO strategy-vault share, not USDC, yoUSD Edge, or yoUSDT. Variable vault exchange rates and liquidity-dependent exits support the non-payment-token classification. No GENIUS issuer authorization or securities exemption is asserted. Exact legal issuer remains unresolved from accessible product materials; issuerEntity is therefore omitted. Underlying-token licensing and attestations are not wrapper-level evidence.
